mathematical_result.kind: independent prose verification with a structural extension
mathematical_result.statement: For the specified projective resolution of an ordinary terminal compact Kahler fourfold and an irreducible singular curve T, dim_Q H_c^2(T0,(R^2 j_* Q)|T0) is at most the number of distinct global exceptional primes over T of ordinary log discrepancy two.
additional_statements: A loop-preserving core gives a bijection of all local and global discrepancy-two places centered on the core and T, respectively.
The curve bound does not require the ambient compact complex fourfold to be Kahler when the specified projective resolution and remaining hypotheses are retained.
